(see PU II v 20–32 and note) and with Hermes’ birth in Hymn to Mercury (Longman iii, no 336) ll. 6–7,
as well as the birth of Belphoebe and Amoretta to Chrysogene through aura seminalis in Faerie Queene

mind the lineage of Persinna, Queen of the Ethiopians, communicated to her daughter Chariklea: ‘[O]
ur line descends from the Sun and Dionysos among gods’ (Heliodorus, Ethiopian Story iv 8, trans.
